page.layout: One blank page: a plain yellowed leaf of a book, seen with the book's spine and cover edge at the left. No printed text, no margin notes.
page.notes: The scan shows a blank leaf (a pastedown or endpaper-like sheet) with no printed words, no page number, no running head, no catchword and no signature. Only the book's binding edge and a few specks of dust or stains appear; these are not printed text and are left out.
